sermon.title: Living in His Presence— August 29, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer gives evidence that Jesus is the same yesterday, today and forever: God declares the end from the beginning, and His presence came and spoke from Eden through the apostles. Then from Hebrews 10 he walks through the tabernacle as a shadow of the church: the door, altar, laver, candlestick, showbread and torn veil, so we can enter His presence boldly by the blood.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The message begins at 21:39 after worship.

faqs.question: What is sinking into your cranial structure?
faqs.answer: That God promised eternal life before He created man.

faqs.question: Didn’t Enoch and Elijah ascend?
faqs.answer: Yes, but they did not come down from heaven.

faqs.question: How was Jesus’ flesh different?
faqs.answer: He says it was half flesh, half spirit, not conceived by a man.

faqs.question: What does the word do to a grumpy old man?
Where is he having success online?
Should we follow a pastor who isn’t following Christ?
What about those who never heard?
faqs.answer: He says if they obeyed God’s laws their conscience would excuse them.
